name: SEMICON-DB
title: SEMICON-DB — Global Semiconductor Equipment Intelligence Graph

batches.note: Keyword web search (titles and search-result summaries; egress-restricted, pages not read). Targets: empty equipment categories and thin OEM portfolios.
Facility-level records for India from government releases (pmindia.gov.in, newsonair.gov.in) and national/industry news, located by web search; facts from titles and search-result summaries.
Site-level facilities outside India (leading-edge and mature-node fabs) from industry news located by web search; facts from titles and search-result summaries.

More site-level facilities (one cancelled project, US advanced packaging, memory fabs) and semiconductor policy programmes (US, EU, Japan, Korea), from government pages, filings and industry news located by web search; titles and search-result summaries.

Official manufacturer pages, press releases, brochures and SEC filings located by web search; titles and URLs captured; page content not read (egress-restricted capture environment). All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED / MEDIUM; no specifications captured.

Small companies and startups found by web search (official product pages, press releases, trade-association directories, investor announcements and industry news). URLs and titles captured; page content not read (egress-restricted capture environment). Company profile facts marked SEARCH_SUMMARY come from search-result summaries of the cited source. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications captured.

Keyword-driven discovery: equipment and process keywords (e.g. wedge bonder, die sorter, film assisted molding, molecular beam epitaxy, sputtering system, wafer flatness, EUV pellicle, photomask repair, MES, dry vacuum pump, abatement scrubber, process chiller, MEMS release etch, OLED inkjet) searched on the web, prioritising equipment categories with no companies. Each company records its discovery keywords. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Ecosystem widening by keyword search: lapping / polishing, probe cards, power-device test, gas delivery, mask writers, microLED transfer, silicon wafers and CMP / FOUP consumables. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Keyword search across dispensing, wire / die bonding, EFEM and load ports, wafer robots, wet stations, plasma etch, particle monitoring, glass (TGV) processing, temporary bonding and thermo-compression bonders. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Regional and layer discovery: Singapore, Malaysia, India (photonics / lasers) and machine vision. URLs and titles captured; pages not read; directory-level evidence for most. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Keyword search across PVD / sputtering, packaging wet processing, ion implantation, AOI, lifetime metrology, motion and vacuum components. URLs and titles captured; pages not read. All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.

Materials and subfab layer plus second-tier equipment: photoresists, wet chemicals, CMP materials, electronic / specialty gases, gas delivery, scrubbers / chillers, wet cleaning, crystal growth, thermal processing, wafer stages. URLs and titles captured from official pages via web search; pages not read. Materials suppliers are recorded at company level (no product models). All records PARTIALLY_VERIFIED; no specifications.
